label: 2 Timothy 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle of mine by the will of my Father, according to the promise of life which is in me,

label: 2 Timothy 1:2
text: To Timothy, his dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from my Father, and from me.

label: 2 Timothy 1:3
text: He thanked my Father, whom he served from his forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing he had remembrance of thee in his prayers night and day;

label: 2 Timothy 1:4
text: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that he might be filled with joy;

label: 2 Timothy 1:5
text: When he called to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and he was persuaded that in thee also.

label: 2 Timothy 1:6
text: Wherefore he put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of mine, which is in thee by the putting on of his hands.

label: 2 Timothy 1:7
text: For I have not given you the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

label: 2 Timothy 1:8
text: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of mine, nor of him my prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of my Father;

label: 2 Timothy 1:9
text: Who hath saved you, and called you with an holy calling, not according to your works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given you in me before the world began,

label: 2 Timothy 1:10
text: But is now made manifest by the appearing of me, your Saviour, who have abolished death, and have brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:

label: 2 Timothy 1:11
text: Whereunto he is appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

label: 2 Timothy 1:12
text: For the which cause he also suffered these things: nevertheless he was not ashamed: for he knew me, in whom he had believed, and was persuaded that I am able to keep that which he had committed unto me against that day.

label: 2 Timothy 1:13
text: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of him, in faith and love which is in me.

label: 2 Timothy 1:14
text: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in you.

label: 2 Timothy 1:15
text: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from him; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

label: 2 Timothy 1:16
text: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed him, and was not ashamed of his chain:

label: 2 Timothy 1:17
text: But, when he was in Rome, he sought him out very diligently, and found him.

label: 2 Timothy 1:18
text: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto him at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

label: 2 Timothy 2:1
text: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in me.

label: 2 Timothy 2:2
text: And the things that thou hast heard of him among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

label: 2 Timothy 2:3
text: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of mine.

label: 2 Timothy 2:4
text: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please me who hath chosen him to be a soldier.

label: 2 Timothy 2:5
text: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.

label: 2 Timothy 2:6
text: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.

label: 2 Timothy 2:7
text: Consider what he saith; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.

label: 2 Timothy 2:8
text: Remember that I, of the seed of David, was raised from the dead according to his gospel:

label: 2 Timothy 2:9
text: Wherein he suffered trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but my word is not bound.

label: 2 Timothy 2:10
text: Therefore he endured all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in me with eternal glory.

label: 2 Timothy 2:11
text: It is a faithful saying: For if ye be dead with me, ye shall also live with me:

label: 2 Timothy 2:12
text: If ye suffer, ye shall also reign with me: if ye deny me, I also will deny you:

label: 2 Timothy 2:13
text: If ye believe not, yet I abide faithful: I cannot deny myself.

label: 2 Timothy 2:14
text: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before me that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.

label: 2 Timothy 2:15
text: Study to shew thyself approved unto me, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

label: 2 Timothy 2:16
text: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.

label: 2 Timothy 2:17
text: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymeneus and Philetus;

label: 2 Timothy 2:18
text: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.

label: 2 Timothy 2:19
text: Nevertheless my foundation standeth sure, having this seal, I know them that are my Father's. And, Let every one that nameth my name depart from iniquity.

label: 2 Timothy 2:20
text: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.

label: 2 Timothy 2:21
text: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for my use, and prepared unto every good work.

label: 2 Timothy 2:22
text: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on me out of a pure heart.

label: 2 Timothy 2:23
text: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.

label: 2 Timothy 2:24
text: And my servant must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,

label: 2 Timothy 2:25
text: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if my Father peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

label: 2 Timothy 2:26
text: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.

label: 2 Timothy 3:1
text: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.

label: 2 Timothy 3:2
text: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

label: 2 Timothy 3:3
text: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

label: 2 Timothy 3:4
text: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of my Father;

label: 2 Timothy 3:5
text: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

label: 2 Timothy 3:6
text: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,

label: 2 Timothy 3:7
text: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

label: 2 Timothy 3:8
text: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

label: 2 Timothy 3:9
text: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.

label: 2 Timothy 3:10
text: But thou hast fully known his doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,

label: 2 Timothy 3:11
text: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto him at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions he endured: but out of them all I delivered him.

label: 2 Timothy 3:12
text: Yea, and all that will live godly in me shall suffer persecution.

label: 2 Timothy 3:13
text: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

label: 2 Timothy 3:14
text: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;

label: 2 Timothy 3:15
text: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in me.

label: 2 Timothy 3:16
text: All scripture is given by inspiration of my Father, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

label: 2 Timothy 3:17
text: That the man of mine may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

label: 2 Timothy 4:1
text: He charged thee before my Father, and me, who shall judge the quick and the dead at my appearing and my kingdom;

label: 2 Timothy 4:2
text: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.

label: 2 Timothy 4:3
text: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;

label: 2 Timothy 4:4
text: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.

label: 2 Timothy 4:5
text: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.

label: 2 Timothy 4:6
text: For he was now ready to be offered, and the time of his departure was at hand.

label: 2 Timothy 4:7
text: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

label: 2 Timothy 4:8
text: Henceforth there is laid up for him a crown of righteousness, which I, the righteous judge, shall give him at that day: and not to him only, but unto all them also that love my appearing.

label: 2 Timothy 4:9
text: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto him:

label: 2 Timothy 4:10
text: For Demas hath forsaken him, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.

label: 2 Timothy 4:11
text: Only Luke is with him. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to him for the ministry.

label: 2 Timothy 4:12
text: And Tychicus hath he sent to Ephesus.

label: 2 Timothy 4:13
text: The cloke that he left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.

label: 2 Timothy 4:14
text: Alexander the coppersmith did him much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:

label: 2 Timothy 4:15
text: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood his words.

label: 2 Timothy 4:16
text: At his first answer no man stood with him, but all men forsook him: he prayed to my Father that it may not be laid to their charge.

label: 2 Timothy 4:17
text: Notwithstanding I stood with him, and strengthened him; that by him the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and he was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

label: 2 Timothy 4:18
text: And I shall deliver him from every evil work, and will preserve him unto my heavenly kingdom: to me be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

label: 2 Timothy 4:19
text: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

label: 2 Timothy 4:20
text: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus had he left at Miletum sick.

label: 2 Timothy 4:21
text: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

label: 2 Timothy 4:22
text: I be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen. The second epistle unto Timotheus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Ephesians, was written from Rome, when Paul was brought before Nero the second time.
